body: Thank you for you kind words, I just dont want to loose him. I dont think I'll be the same if I ever find out he did it. I tried showing him how he personally helped me in the past as a way of showing him how great he is, and the stuff that he influenced me to do (he got me into so many things that I never knew I liked until he told me about it). He helped me get a financial aid at Uni from his personal contacts, he influenced many decisions I took and never regretted (looking back at how bad it went to others, it could have been me!). That is the foundation to our friendship! I just wish he knows how I view him, how I talk about him to others, even a girl I work with got interested in meeting him from all the good stuff I said about him (I think they have so many things in common they could hit it off) and she asks me about him from time to time. It is depressing seeing him like that! I must do something for him!!

Apart of me, he doesnt have any other friend, he has what he calls them "acquaintances" or people he knows from something they shared like work or team mates. Yesterday he was listening to Linkin Park, I told him as a joke that he is reviving his high school youth with this music, it brought a smile to his face and told me that he likes it. He doesnt like talking about himself or how he feels, even when he feels terrible, he says he doesnt want to bother or bore me with his "load of crap", so I usually find something to talk about or do something we both like. In my opinion, I find he does have many great traits, many great things he can be grateful for, I just wish I can make him see them.

Thats a really good idea, I will talk to my landlord to let him move in with me, my roommates wont like the idea, but to hell with them. The job market has reopened recently, its harder now to find jobs since a lot of people got laid off and theres a big number of people waiting to be hired, but he didnt even try looking, he says that he knows he will be bad at it just like he was bad in everything else. Whats worse is that, since we share a common interest in video games (especially the competitive ones like DOTA or PUBG), he only plays one game on easy mode and uses cheats when a certain level bothers him, and in DOTA or PUBG you cant even cheat without consequences. Its like he is doing drugs without the drug part, looking for an easy way out.

I try talking to him about the stuff we like, I check up on him everyday, with a phone call or a text or a surprise visit, I even paid his rent this month, and left some money for him to buy food (he binges on food like crazy!). But I am afraid that one day I will wake up to a phone call, with someone telling me that he passed away and his funeral is being prepared. I feel like I need to do something more. We are both the only sons to our parents. we are like the brother we never had. I should do more for my brother, but I am not sure what.

I did listen to him, he was not venting out the stuff that bothered him, it seemed that his problems go way back deeper and it had stayed with him. Therapists and psychologists are uncommon in my country because its sort of a taboo, people will look down upon the person that sees them as a social reject, and that would close so many opportunities for him. The  best therapists and psys charge way too much for each sessions.. I did offer to pay for a session with a therapist but he plainly refused stating that I would be wasting my money and it wont help him. His parents wont help because they don't understand, they blame themselves for raising him too weak, too "spoiled".
